e.title: GranMoMoRS
e.summary: 粒度死亡率三态转换模型代码（Robben，2★，arXiv 2503.04568）：温度与流行病冲击驱动的死亡率偏离建模
e.body: GranMoMoRS（JensRobben/GranMoMoRS，2★，学术背书）是论文《Granular mortality modeling with temperature and epidemic shocks: a three-state regime-switching approach》（arXiv 2503.04568，Robben 等）的 R 配套代码：用三态（基线/温度冲击/流行病冲击）体制转换框架建模死亡率偏离季节基线的变动——温度与流行病冲击驱动的粒度死亡率。对 RIAA：气候驱动的死亡率建模前沿——与 [[soa-cc230-climate-mortality]]（SOA 气候死亡率研究）、[[soa-mim-2026]]（美国 MIM）、[[mortality-dynamics]]（KU Leuven 教学）配套；极端温度对死亡率的影响衔接 [[stmomo]]（随机死亡率）与气候风险（[[ml-drought]] 热浪侧）。
e.verified_note: raw README+arXiv 核实：三态体制转换粒度死亡率模型论文配套（Robben），学术背书入池
e.summary_en: Granular mortality three-state regime-switching model code (Robben, 2★, arXiv 2503.04568): mortality deviations driven by temperature and epidemic shocks
e.summary_hk: 粒度死亡率三態轉換模型程式碼（Robben，2★，arXiv 2503.04568）：溫度與流行病衝擊驅動的死亡率偏離建模
e.body_en: GranMoMoRS (JensRobben/GranMoMoRS, 2★, academic-backed) is the R companion code to the paper "Granular mortality modeling with temperature and epidemic shocks: a three-state regime-switching approach" (arXiv 2503.04568, Robben et al.): a three-state (baseline / temperature-shock / epidemic-shock) regime-switching framework models mortality deviations from seasonal baselines driven by temperature and epidemic shocks — granular, climate-driven mortality. For RIAA: the frontier of climate-driven mortality modelling — pairs with [[soa-cc230-climate-mortality]] (the SOA climate-mortality study), [[soa-mim-2026]] (the US mortality-improvement model) and [[mortality-dynamics]] (KU Leuven teaching); temperature extremes link to [[stmomo]] (stochastic mortality) and climate risk (the heatwave side of [[ml-drought]]).
e.body_hk: GranMoMoRS（JensRobben/GranMoMoRS，2★，學術背書）是論文《Granular mortality modeling with temperature and epidemic shocks: a three-state regime-switching approach》（arXiv 2503.04568，Robben 等）的 R 配套程式碼：用三態（基線/溫度衝擊/流行病衝擊）體制轉換框架建模死亡率偏離季節基線的變動——溫度與流行病衝擊驅動的粒度死亡率。對 RIAA：氣候驅動的死亡率建模前沿——與 [[soa-cc230-climate-mortality]]（SOA 氣候死亡率研究）、[[soa-mim-2026]]（美國 MIM）、[[mortality-dynamics]]（KU Leuven 教學）配套；極端溫度對死亡率的影響銜接 [[stmomo]]（隨機死亡率）與氣候風險（[[ml-drought]] 熱浪側）。
